description: Impact of weather and hydro variability on the operation of the Bolivian power system. is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sulmayra Zarate, Matija Pavičević (Universidad Mayor de San Simón). This DataSet is the support for the study of the Impact of climate variability on the hydroelectric generation of the Bolivian electrical system, for which a hydrological model (WEAP) and unit commitment and optimal dispatch model (DispaSet) have been used. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
